data.exact_reserve_text: Movement in 2015 of GBP (3.2)m comprising claims charges of GBP (3.4)m, GBP (0.2)m of additional reinsurance accruals, GBP 0.2m of expense adjustments and investment income of GBP 0.2m. Of the adverse claims movement of GBP 3.4m in the year ended 31 December 2015, GBP 0.4m related to the older years 2006-2010 which appear to have achieved a degree of stability, GBP 2.2m to the 2011 year of account and GBP 0.8m to the pure year of account.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a total gross prior year strengthening of GBP 3.4 million in 2015, representing 10.55% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by claims charges across the 2012 year of account and older years (2006-2011), with specific mentions of adverse movement in the liability class of business. Recalibration of liability loss ratios and significant property losses from 2015 CAT events, including Storm Desmond, also contributed to the strengthening for the 2014 year of account. Additionally, ongoing uncertainty regarding potential Australian tax rebates for the 2012 and 2013 years of account and general reserving volatility led to these years being placed into run-off.
